status: Declared before new equilibrium audit or closed-loop execution; target feasibility is a prerequisite, not assumed.
question: Does a verified state/input goal target with dynamics-derived terminal value correct the previous MPC goal retreat?

fixed.observer: same momentum observer + contact locator, hardware mode, exact simulated qpos/qvel
fixed.stage_weights: Same AffineMPCSettings state/input/change weight magnitudes as I-30
fixed.original_goal_and_clock: unchanged, fixed at measured warm-end origin plus16mm

audit_first: Original analytic rest target at frozen post-pulse Y anchors: all9 acceleration residuals, bounded holding inputs, private-model support and .4s hold drift.
If needed find nearby rest configuration with fixed goalXY, no live-state reset.
Check local recovery/linearization behavior; failed Riccati/stabilizability tests recorded.
candidate_conditional: One verified equilibrium-centered state/input target + local dynamics terminal value, only if audit supports using it. No coefficient search or automatic default promotion.

acceptance.peak_lean: no worse than I-30 matching direction
acceptance.strong_x_rms: no more than10% worse than matching I-30
acceptance.physical: complete, no falls, actual bounds respected

limitations: Private model audits are not new Gazebo tests or hardware evidence.
Equilibrium existence does not guarantee goal reachable within .4s.
Local derivative smoothness/stabilizability and real-time execution are not assumed.

audit_prerequisites.support: positive private-model normal load, no support injection, no real contact inputs
audit_prerequisites.local_model: half/double FD epsilon audit and small disturbance recovery; preserve weak goal direction; finite tail must be labeled, no pole clipping
audit_prerequisites.stop: If target hold or a defensible terminal model fails, preserve audit and do not launch new closed-loop candidate. A failed numerical solve does not prove physical unreachability.
